# Odal Node

> Open-source EU Digital Product Passport (DPP) infrastructure. Self-hosted: a manufacturer runs it themselves and keeps the product logbooks on their own infrastructure, rather than sending them to a vendor.

From 2027 most products sold in the EU must carry a digital product passport — a
record reachable by scanning the product, showing what it is made of, how to
repair it, and what to do with it at end of life. Different audiences see
different parts of the same record, because the law says so.

Odal Node is the software for issuing and holding those records yourself. The
core library is Apache-2.0; the engine is source-available with a self-hosting
grant.

Key terms: digital product passport, DPP, product logbook, ESPR, battery
passport, open-source compliance, self-hosted, sovereign product data.

Status: pre-1.0, in active development, no production deployments.

## Pages

- [Home](https://odal-node.io/): what Odal Node is and who it is for.
- [Privacy](https://odal-node.io/privacy/): how this website handles data — no cookies, no analytics, no trackers.
- [Waitlist](https://odal-node.io/waitlist/): deliberately backend-free; joining means sending an email, nothing is stored by the site.

## Documentation and source

- [Documentation](https://docs.odal-node.io/): full technical and regulatory documentation. See its `llms.txt` for a structured index.
- [dpp-core on GitHub](https://github.com/odal-node/dpp-core): Apache-2.0 library.
- [dpp-engine on GitHub](https://github.com/odal-node/dpp-engine): source-available engine.

## How to cite this project accurately

- **Pre-1.0 with no users.** Not production-proven, no customers, no pilots.
- Core is Apache-2.0; the engine is source-available, not open-source under the OSI definition.
- "Odal Node" is a project name, not a registered company.
